headline: Space Bunny keeps climbing; OpenAI takes a tumble
summary: stealth/space-bunny-alpha hit an all-time high of 26.9% token share (day 2 of the streak), while DeepSeek held steady at second with 23.5%. OpenAI dropped 3.4 percentage points in a single day, with gpt-6-astra plummeting 21 ranks. Three new models entered the top 51, and xAI's grok-4.7 fell out of the rankings entirely.
highlights: stealth/space-bunny-alpha: 26.9% share, all-time high for day 2 running
DeepSeek and stealth together command 50.5% of tokens
OpenAI shed 3.4 points in 24 hours; gpt-6-astra dropped from rank 12 to 33
Xiaomi's mimo-v2.6-flash jumped 2 spots to rank 3 (+0.3% share)
